judgeRules.fact: 10事实题为分母，模型上屏、全部子问有原文支持，不能删条件、否定或比较词。原文降级不算模型成功。
judgeRules.gate: 事实≥80%、4守门全对、上屏事实出处支持100%、无未支持断言；时延独立≤8000ms。

independenceBoundary: Frozen before any 1200-token model result. New wordings, same limited corpus, maintainer-designed and implementation-aware, no independent human/student generalization. Do not tune on this batch.
